function GoogleCircle({ center, radius, options }) {
  _s();
  const map = useMap();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!map || typeof google === "undefined") return;
    const circle = new google.maps.Circle({ center, radius, ...options });
    circle.setMap(map);
    return () => {
      circle.setMap(null);
    };
  }, [map, center.lat, center.lng, radius, JSON.stringify(options)]);
  return null;
}
